list.title: Homebrew
list.description: Packs of your own content, private until you share them.
list.titleHint: What the pack is called when people see it.
list.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Entries are keyed under it, so it cannot change later.
list.createFailed: Could not create the pack. Try again.
list.entries: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
list.empty: No packs yet. Create one to start writing your own content.

pack.slugTaken: That slug is already used by another pack. Pick a different one.
pack.title: Pack
pack.visibilityPrivate: Private: only you can see it
pack.visibilityCampaign: Campaign: members of campaigns that enable it
pack.visibilityHint: Only you can change this. Official packs are always public.
pack.visibilityForbidden: Only the pack’s owner can change who can see it.
pack.visibilityFailed: Could not change who can see this pack. Try again.
pack.campaignsEnableIt: These campaigns still enable this pack: {campaigns}. Remove it from them before making it private.
pack.dependencyCycle: {dependency} already extends this pack, directly or through other packs, so this pack cannot extend it.
pack.dependencyNarrower: This pack is visible to more people than {dependency}. Narrow who can see this pack first.
pack.dependencyInUse: These entries still use it: {entries}. Remove those references first.
pack.widerThanDependencies: This pack extends {packs}, which fewer people can see. It cannot be visible to more people than what it extends.
pack.narrowerThanDependents: {count, plural, one {# pack that extends this one is} other {# packs that extend this one are}} visible to more people than this. Narrow {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first.
pack.extendedByPacks: {count, plural, one {# pack extends this one} other {# packs extend this one}}. Archive {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first, or stop them extending it.
pack.dependsOnArchived: {count, plural, one {# pack this one extends is} other {# packs this one extends are}} archived. Restore {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} first.

dependencies.heading: Extends
dependencies.hint: Entries in this pack can reference anything in the packs it extends, and nothing else. A pack cannot be visible to more people than what it extends.
dependencies.loadError: Could not load the packs this one extends.
dependencies.removeFailed: Could not remove it. Try again.
dependencies.noneToAdd: No other pack can be added right now.
dependencies.addFailed: Could not add it. Try again.
